시편 150:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

시편 150:2.content: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

시편 150:3.content: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

시편 150:4.content: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

시편 150:5.content: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

시편 150:6.content: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.
